label: Emblems of Durin's Folk
license: supplied to the archive; rights confirmed by the site's owner
author: Rondador Nocturno (monogram ROH/NOC on the source plate)
why: canon-complete where the Commons relief was not: “an anvil and a hammer surmounted by a crown with seven stars” (LotR II.4), all four present, and drawn flat rather than as a shaded three-dimensional panel. The crop takes the shield and leaves the artist's monogram outside it, so his name is carried in words instead — here, in the published asset index, and in the credit line under the hall.

superseded_commons.author: Rondador, after Wappen Neuenstein (Hohenlohe).svg
superseded_commons.modified: background rectangle removed 2026-07-26 (fill #f0f0f0 over the whole canvas): every other device in the hall stands on the card's own ground, and this one alone sat in a grey box. The emblem itself is untouched. CC BY-SA 3.0 permits the change; the attribution above is unaltered.

label: Emblem of the Silmarils
license: unattributed; rights confirmed by the site's owner
author: unattributed
why: a tree bearing three faceted jewels among yellow fruit, which is the structure of Tolkien's own drawing; it replaces a forge device that was pale and sparse beside it

label: The badge of Elendil — L·ND·L
license: unattributed; rights confirmed by the site's owner
author: unattributed
why: L·ND·L in tengwar upon sable. The forge's own setting of the same letters, on parchment within a square, stays in the bench: a square is Tolkien's shape for an impersonal emblem, and which is righter for a badge worn on a seal is a question the sources do not settle.

label: Emblem of the Flying Corps of Mordor
license: unattributed; rights confirmed by the site's owner
author: unattributed
why: Tolkien drew and titled this emblem himself, 'seen from below'. The supplied drawing has the segmented body, the eyed wings and the pale pinions; the forge device it replaces had the structure and none of the drawing.

label: House of Finwë — the Winged Sun
license: unattributed; rights confirmed by the site's owner
author: unattributed
why: its ground measures #786090 against #786060 for the drawing this archive files as the House of Finwë — the same dusty mauve — and it carries that device's flame-rays, dashed ring and spoked heart. A better drawing of it than the forge makes.
